official_title: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts – Analysis of the final compromise text with a view to agreement

institution_roles.evidence_locator: Official Public Register exact result for ST 5662 2024 INIT lists Originator: Presidency and Addressee: Permanent Representatives Committee.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Official Presidency text of the final interinstitutional compromise before formal first-reading adoption.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The PDF was issued 26 January; the Council release explicitly records that it added the exact compromise text on 2 February 2024. Institutional attribution follows the register's Presidency originator field rather than treating negotiated content as Parliament authorship.

document_date.locator: ST 5662/24 cover: Brussels, 26 January 2024; final compromise text with a view to agreement.
document_date.meaning: Establishes 2024-01-26 as the issue date of this exact version.

publication_date.meaning: Establishes 2024-02-02 as the dated official publication manifestation of the exact ST 5662/24 version.

classification_evidence.locator: ST 5662/24, note subject and annex: final compromise text for the Artificial Intelligence Act, including AI-system scope, prohibited practices and high-risk rules.
classification_evidence.rationale: AI regulation is the document's central subject.

classification_evidence.locator: ST 5662/24 annex applies horizontal AI rules across the Union market and multiple public/private domains.
classification_evidence.rationale: The compromise is cross-sector rather than confined to one economic sector.
